subject: dog bowl
title: What If You Never Washed Your Dog's Bowl?

scenes.text: What if you never washed your dog's bowl? That slimy film inside? It's alive.
Within a week, bacteria counts in dogs' water bowls rose significantly in a UK university study.
By day 14, swabs from some bowls had turned up dangerous bacteria, including Salmonella and MRSA.
A US household germ study ranked pet dishes the fourth germiest place in the entire home.
Yet fewer than 5 percent of 417 dog owners surveyed had heard of the FDA's pet food hygiene advice.
And the bowl works both ways. Researchers say it can pass germs from dog to human, and from human back to dog.
